preserves: Original upl_p3_pair_r1.cpp/.ps1/declaration, sealed Debug/Release outputs and review remain unchanged. No production source, object or solver is used or replaced.

new_operator_only.name: symC_Lstar_plus_receiverC_DAce

new_operator_only.gravity: Ace=a_s-g; do not append the old head gravity term. The physical pointwise q diagnostic remains -k/gamma_ref*(Gp+rho_water*Ace).
new_operator_only.tradeoff: First-order consistency correction is receiver-dependent and not a reciprocal pair flux. Frozen global storage budget and full-patch pressure-energy sign are diagnostic for this new operator, not assumed identities or fluid-mass conservation.

old_control_proof.source_bound: Current old CPP hash must match its prior successful build receipt; no rebaseline or retained-output overwrite.
old_control_proof.not_claimed: No old physical solver or notifier is restarted. This is a fresh standalone deterministic implementation control.

geometry_and_material: Exactly the old81/729-node regular/jittered frozen reciprocal patches, dp=1/8,h=dp,eta2=h^2/100,Jheterogeneous,nJ,VJ,rho_water1000,Kw2e8,k2^-10,gamma_ref8000. The independently signed body gravity does not change gamma_ref.

support_scope.core: Reference indices abs<=1:9/27 receiver full-support nodes. Outer truncated rows are not physical walls.
support_scope.central_double_support: Explicitly verify central IDs40/364 and every retained kernel neighbor's C support. First omitted reference coordinate has magnitude at least5dp-dp/8; require this minus abs(node coordinate) minus2h strictly positive on each active axis. Central displacement is bounded by dp/8. Thus central plus neighbor correction supports cannot reach an omitted node of the same bounded-jitter lattice.
support_scope.output: central_support.csv records4 checks, affected-node counts and minimum positive clearance. Do not generalize this proof to all core nodes, periodic copies or real boundaries.

fields.old13: Retain every old field, including freefall g-/g+, stationary hydrostatic, accelerated equilibrium, constant flux, quadratic plus affine acceleration and k0 compression/dilation/zero trace.
fields.new14: Quadratic pressure with Ace=-grad(reference p)/rho_water, physical q_reference0 and continuum pressure rate0; compare ALL4 operators without assuming Lstar quadratic exactness.
fields.independent_quadratic_pressure_bases: 2D xx,xz,zz (3);3D xx,xy,xz,yy,yz,zz (6). Diagonal p=2048+512*x_a^2, cross p=2048+1024*x_a*x_b. Ace0,g0; analytic Laplacian1024 for diagonal,0 for cross.
fields.independent_affine_acceleration_bases: All active B_ab:2D4 and3D9. Ace_a=x_b/16, other components0,pconstant2048,g0; analytic div Ace=1/16 whena=b,else0. Constant-pressure pointwise Darcy flux is nontrivial; newstar rate is an exact-field hard comparison.
fields.k0_scope: Only unchanged old fields7,8,9 use k0. New14 and all independent pressure/acceleration bases retain nonzero k.

hard_gates.old_control_hashes: All5 complete output files identical to sealed controls, both configurations independently; all old beta, residual, frozen weighted-budget and pure-pressure energy gates remain unmodified in the included source.
hard_gates.new_star_exact_fields: For every affine-pressure field (including constant pressure/constant flux, old equilibrium/freefall/static cases, k0 fields and all affine Ace bases), compare all nodes against Kw/ni*(k/gamma_ref*continuum-theta), not just central nodes.
hard_gates.new_star_roundoff_tolerance_pa_s: 4096*DBL_EPSILON*max(1, gain*(sum_abs_Lp_terms + abs(Gp) dot sum_abs_Lx_terms +rho_water*sum_abs_D_Ace_terms +abs(continuum)) +abs(compression)) +1e-7; gain=Kw/ni*k/gamma_ref, compression=-Kw/ni*theta. No empirical adjustment after running.
hard_gates.central_support: Positive omitted-node clearance for central plus every kernel neighbor C support in all4 patches.
hard_gates.core_pressure_matrix_shape: Each4-operator/4-patch matrix is an actual frozen rate operator assembled by unit1-Pa pressure basis on every9/27 core node, all outer p0,Ace0,theta0. Require all6480 entries present exactly once, storage weights positive/consistent and all finite.
hard_gates.core_pressure_energy_matrix: S=diag(Vi ni/Kw),B=sqrt(S) A invsqrt(S). For each of16 matrices require both lambda_max((B+B^T)/2) and max Re(lambda(B)) <=4096*eps_float64*max(1,norm2(B)). No post-run threshold increase. Export maxima,min symmetric eigenvalue,norm and tolerance.
hard_gates.tool_provenance: Capture compiler arguments, frozen source/header/recipe hashes, actual exits, generated file hashes and Python/NumPy versions; no production program/cloud-binary-backup claim.

diagnostics_not_hard_acceptance: Newstar frozen global weighted Darcy/total budget and global pressure-energy derivative are reported, not constrained to the reciprocal identities of the old pair operator.
All independent quadratic continuum errors, quadratic balanced-q0 residuals and receiver-C pointwise q errors are reported at core/outer/central locations. No quadratic exactness is assumed.
Pointwise receiver-C q is a SEPARATE diagnostic, not a proved vector flux whose discrete divergence equals Lstar or pairR.

The frozen core Dirichlet restriction supplies an explicit pressure-energy closure screen; it is not a physical boundary-particle implementation, unconditional coupled stability, or a general periodic/Dirichlet/Neumann closure proof.
Heterogeneous J is assigned independently from a physical trajectory; regular-versus-jitter comparisons do not isolate volume disorder from positional disorder.

outputs_and_order.build: Standalone MSVC Debug first, Release only after review of any earlier rejection. No production objects. Used new/old CPP,PS1,declaration snapshots retained in unique build directory.
outputs_and_order.run: Fresh *_run and sibling *_run_control; preserve prior labels. New C++ stage writes summary.csv,core.csv,dirichlet_matrices.csv,central_support.csv,complete.json. Dedicated quadratic_balance.csv retains6480 all-node/operator rows of the actual14th field, including rate/reference/error and pointwise q/q_reference; not an abstract residual-only assessment. Old5-file hash proof precedes offline NumPy matrix screen. Matrix gate rejection seals its energy.check.json and holds later stages.
outputs_and_order.bounded_size: Compact new summaries/core rows and6480 matrix entries; no full all-node arithmetic dump for the added basis fields. The old63180-row control CSV is retained solely for complete byte-equivalence proof.
outputs_and_order.failure_policy: A completed standalone stage plus analysis failure requires offline repair only, never automatic rerun. Any algebraic or energy rejection retains evidence and holds later configurations/admission without relaxed gates.
